experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit status calculation in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The relay incorrectly maps SIGINT to exit code 143 (128+15) instead of the conventional shell value 130 (128+2).
experiment.falsifier: Running the probe again with the proposed fix must return exit code 130. If it still returns 143, the hypothesis is false.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Preserves child process exit status as per the relay's contract, fixing the SIGINT handling bug.

limits: A reported issue is not permission to contact its author, endorsement, demand validation or evidence that our product solves it.
